custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part at the test location, so the Inactive tab lists a row.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839421-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839421-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The checkbox column and the dark bar appear.

Step 3:

  • A hover text reading "Clear selection" appears.

Step 4:

  • Bulk mode ends, and the checkbox column and the bar disappear.

Step 5:

  • The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export" again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
  • S2-R9a: “The X leaves the mode, clears the selection and puts the toolbar back to its normal state.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
